description: A step of the build-scatter test groups: every unit removed while site B's four ARMPW are walking off it and their builder waits, so each row's unit and the site's builder are gone at the next step; then a third site's units in their place -- an ARMCK at the pinned camera centre and four idle ARMPW on the corners of the place where site A stood, the four cells at its middle left free for build-scatter-wreck.json's wreck.
